results.title: Pakistan beat India by three wickets in U-19 Asia Cup
results.content: India were bowled out for a modest 208 and Pakistan, after a top-order wobble, managed to complete the chase, with Hamza Zahoor taking the team home with an excellent, unbeaten 100 off 108 balls after coming in at number seven

results.title: Delhi records ‘very poor’ air quality on Diwali with 376 AQI
results.content: Jahangirpuri recorded the highest AQI at 450, followed by RK Puram at 448, according to the Sameer app.

results.title: Portion of false ceiling collapses outside Mumbai airport terminal, one hurt
results.content: The airport's emergency medical team rushed to the spot immediately after the incident outside the terminal building and provided first aid to the injured individual

results.title: Watch: Delhi air pollution: Capital sees ‘very poor’ AQI on Deepavali as GRAP 3 curbs continue
results.content: Delhi recorded ‘very poor’ air quality on Deepavali, with the overall AQI at 383 in the morning and improving marginally to 378 by 3:00 PM. However, several monitoring stations continued to log ‘severe’ pollution levels, led by Jahangirpuri at 461 and Rohini at 447.

results.title: Deepavali 2026: How ready-to-drink cocktails are changing India’s festive drinking scene
results.content: From rasmalai-inspired cocktails to jamun mint and guava chilli, ready-to-drink beverages are bringing Indian flavours to Deepavali parties, reflecting changing tastes and a growing market for convenient cocktails

results.title: Bangladesh Law Minister calls Hasina ‘convicted criminal’, says extradition request sent to India
results.content: Indian govt previously acknowledged receiving Bangladesh's extradition requests for Ms. Hasina but has not announced any decision on handing her over

results.title: Agitation against CEC will go on till he is removed: Venugopal
results.content: ‘We will withdraw from this agitation only after Gyanesh Kumar is removed from the post and steps are taken to make India's electoral system and processes flawless, impartial and fair,’ said K.C. Venugopal

results.title: Congress donations fall nearly 75%, sharpest decline in a decade
results.content: Congress had received ₹517.39 crore in such contributions in 2024-25, according to its 2024-25 contribution report submitted to the Election Commission of India

results.title: Dangerous harmonies: Is there a hidden villain in India’s devastating electrical fires?
results.content: Electrical causes are predominating in India’s recent fire incidents; while codes and guidelines are covering these increasingly, there are still major gaps such as taking into account harmonic currents put into the system by state-of-the-art electronics equipment

results.title: Sanskrit University suspension row: Govindan backs stir, says it should go on till suspended students write exams
results.content: Sixteen students were suspended after a Students’ Federation of India-led protest during a syndicate meeting on August 13 over a lack of adequate campus facilities

results.title: BJP celebrates Advani’s birthday with puja, havan; leaders laud his role in Indian politics
results.content: The event, coinciding with Deepavali, was organised to commemorate Mr. Advani’s life, dedication to the nation, organisational contributions and long public career, the BJP said
